method: Static source audit of all .luau files under src/ (grep + read) plus a new source-audit spec that locks the safe patterns. StreamingEnabled was NOT enabled in Studio; the setting and its fps/LOD trade-off are a designer decision.

breakdown.replicatedstorage_shared_no_timeout: every client module boot-straps Shared with WaitForChild('Shared'); ReplicatedStorage is always replicated, so no streaming dependency
breakdown.remotes_with_timeout: src/shared/Remotes.luau: WaitForChild('Remotes', 30) and folder:WaitForChild(name, 10) — both bounded
breakdown.playergui_no_timeout: src/client/UI/Theme.luau:311 — player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui'); PlayerGui is always replicated to its owner

safe_collection_service_tags.emitted: src/server/Farm/PlotService.luau:92 (comment explicitly says works with streaming)

world_part_discovery.why_safe: CollectionService tags travel with the instance as it streams; added/removed signals handle late arrival and departure. Polling consumers (Audio.musicAt every ZONE_POLL, Phone.refreshCheatTab) re-evaluate, so a streamed-in instance appears on a later tick.

guarded_snapshot.verdict: safe: nil-guarded on both world and ownerUserId, re-run on every refreshCheatTab tick, and the primary tile read is CollectionService:GetTagged('Tile')

dev_only_limitation.issue: one-time Workspace:FindFirstChild/GetDescendants snapshot with no DescendantAdded re-scan; if a hub part is streamed out at the moment a candidate is enabled, the material/prop attachment can miss it
dev_only_limitation.verdict: acceptable: all four are LookDev review tools, off by default, never ship, and are used in a small Studio-only review area; no delivered art or shipping path affected. Parked for the designer with the StreamingEnabled decision.

world_part_discovery.no_unguarded_direct_index: No workspace.World.X dot chains or unchecked child indexing of a world part in the shipping client were found; every GetTagged result is IsA/attribute checked and every FindFirstChild on a tile/status/crop is nil-guarded.

cases_detail: no client WaitForChild on a streamable path is missing its timeout
the WaitForChild classifier flags unbounded world waits and accepts bounded ones (self-check)
every world-part consumer discovers instances through CollectionService tags
shipping workspace child snapshots are only a supplement to tag discovery

mutation_check.result: 1 FAILED, 1971 passed, exit 1 — error named the file and the unbounded call

validation.lune: All 1972 tests passed (1968 before this item, +4 cases)

designer_proposal: Do not flip StreamingEnabled from an agent. If the designer enables it to reduce initial load on low-tier devices, run G6 fps and the full Q5 multi-client pass before accepting; the four LookDev review tools may need a DescendantAdded re-scan (dev-only, off by default). Added to WORK_QUEUE 'Decisions for designer'.
